passage.label: believers told space yourselves in assemblies then make space and Allah will make space for you, told arise then arise, Allah raises those who believed and those given knowledge by degrees, Acquainted with what you do; when wishing to privately consult the Messenger present before consultation a charity, better and purer, if means not found Allah Forgiving Merciful; feared to present charities before consultation, when you do not and Allah has forgiven you then establish prayer give zakah and obey Allah and His Messenger, Acquainted with what you do

arabicExcerpts.text: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمۡ تَفَسَّحُواْ فِي ٱلۡمَجَٰلِسِ فَٱفۡسَحُواْ يَفۡسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمۡۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُواْ فَٱنشُزُواْ يَرۡفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ مِنكُمۡ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُواْ ٱلۡعِلۡمَ دَرَجَٰتٖۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِذَا نَٰجَيۡتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَةٗۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ لَّكُمۡ وَأَطۡهَرُۚ فَإِن لَّمۡ تَجِدُواْ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ

ءَأَشۡفَقۡتُمۡ أَن تُقَدِّمُواْ بَيۡنَ يَدَيۡ نَجۡوَىٰكُمۡ صَدَقَٰتٖۚ فَإِذۡ لَمۡ تَفۡعَلُواْ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُواْ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرُۢ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ

mainSubject.label: Assembly etiquette commanding believers to make room when asked and to rise when told, with Allah making space for them and raising believers and the knowledgeable by degrees under His acquaintance with their deeds; private consultation with the Messenger preceded by charity as better and purer, with concession when means are lacking under forgiveness and mercy; when the charity requirement proves too burdensome and pardon is granted, the standing obligations of prayer, zakah and obedience to Allah and His Messenger are reaffirmed

notes: Wave 9 genuine re-extraction. Boundaries follow the text: P1 closes with the zihar expiation ladder and divine limits (4) before the opposition-and-abasement block opens (5); P2 ends with the Satanic-whispering diagnosis and reliance command (10) before assembly etiquette begins (11); P3 covers assembly conduct and the consultation-charity rule with its concession (11-13); P4 runs from the false-alliance critique through the two parties to the closing success declaration (14-22).
